# M54 parity matrix

Written by `cargo test --release -p op-engine --test m54_parity m54_write_parity_matrix -- --ignored --test-threads=1` (engine/op-engine/tests/m54_parity.rs). Do not edit by hand.

- Machine: Apple M2, 8 cores, 8 GB RAM, macOS 27.0.1. GPU adapter: Apple M2 (Metal).
- Load average before: { 8.49 6.54 9.82 }; after: { 2.62 3.04 4.39 }. Run time 1707 s.
- Fixtures: the five oracle inputs (tests/fixtures) and a synthetic 600 × 400 image (3 × 2 tiles, partial edge tiles).
- Backends: CPU is op-ops' parallel tile scheduler. Engine GPU is `Engine::dispatch` with the GPU on and 192 px chunks, read back from the layer tiles. op-gpu is `GpuContext::effect_kernel` on the whole image; that entry point takes kernel defaults, so it runs the default set only.
- Parameter sets: default; every legacy capture's parameters; each numeric parameter at min, min+1, mid, max-1 and max; floats at min, mid, mid+0.5 and max; each flag flipped; every choice. Sets with a window (radius, softness, brush, thickness, pencil tip, sharpen amount) over 50 px that have no legacy capture run on the three 64 × 64 inputs only; their large-input cells say not run.
- Working space: every effect declares one (Encoded) except Gaussian, whose gamma choice and linear-light flag are listed in the Space column.
- Reference: legacy-3.36 rows compare against the capture PNG with the same input and parameters. Own rows have no external capture, so the CPU twin is the reference and the GPU rows report CPU-GPU error.
- Max reference error is the largest channel difference; mismatches count channels that differ at all. A CPU cell fails when its error is over the row tolerance. A GPU cell fails when its CPU-GPU error is over the kernel tolerance (tests/gpu_effects.rs). GPU rows also report their own error against the capture.
- Time is wall-clock milliseconds for one render including tile reads and writes (and, for the engine, GPU upload, dispatch and readback). Peak memory is the peak of new CPU heap bytes during the cell, in MB, from a counting allocator; GPU memory is not measured. Pipeline is cold for the first run of a kernel on that GPU context and warm after.

## CPU-only effects

- `effect.adjust.auto_level`: CPU only: op-ops registers no GPU kernel (passes [Reduction, Pointwise])
- `effect.adjust.hue_saturation`: CPU only: op-ops registers no GPU kernel (passes [Pointwise])
- `effect.render.julia_fractal`: CPU only: op-ops registers no GPU kernel (passes [Iterative])
- `effect.render.mandelbrot_fractal`: CPU only: op-ops registers no GPU kernel (passes [Iterative])
- `effect.color.quantize`: CPU only: op-ops registers no GPU kernel (passes [Reduction, Pointwise])
- `effect.distort.crystalize`: CPU only: op-ops registers no GPU kernel (passes [Warp])
- `effect.distort.dents`: CPU only: op-ops registers no GPU kernel (passes [Warp])
- `effect.distort.frosted_glass`: CPU only: op-ops registers no GPU kernel (passes [Neighborhood])
- `effect.distort.polar_inversion`: CPU only: op-ops registers no GPU kernel (passes [Warp])
- `effect.distort.tile_reflection`: CPU only: op-ops registers no GPU kernel (passes [Warp])
- `effect.object.drop_shadow`: CPU only: op-ops registers no GPU kernel (passes [Neighborhood])
- `effect.fill.content_aware`: CPU only: op-ops registers no GPU kernel (passes [Iterative])
- `effect.layers.rotate_zoom`: CPU only: op-ops registers no GPU kernel (passes [Warp])

## Long chains

CPU engine vs GPU engine on the 600 × 400 image, 192 px GPU chunks. Each step shows the worst channel error after that effect.

- Mixed chain (held to 2/255 by m54_mixed_ten_effect_chain_stays_within_two_channels): final 1/255, 37677 channels differ. Steps: effect.blur.gaussian 1 → effect.adjust.brightness_contrast 1 → effect.blur.motion 1 → effect.adjust.sepia 0 → effect.photo.sharpen 0 → effect.stylize.emboss 1 → effect.blur.unfocus 1 → effect.photo.vignette 1 → effect.blur.square 1 → effect.blur.bokeh 1.
- Gain chain (Glow in place of Bokeh; reported only): final 3/255, 49425 channels differ. Steps: effect.blur.gaussian 1 → effect.adjust.brightness_contrast 1 → effect.blur.motion 1 → effect.adjust.sepia 0 → effect.photo.sharpen 0 → effect.stylize.emboss 1 → effect.blur.unfocus 1 → effect.photo.vignette 1 → effect.blur.square 1 → effect.photo.glow 3.
- Ranking chain (Reduce Noise and Glow in place of Square Blur and Bokeh; reported only): final 18/255, 121593 channels differ. Steps: effect.blur.gaussian 1 → effect.adjust.brightness_contrast 1 → effect.blur.motion 1 → effect.adjust.sepia 0 → effect.photo.sharpen 0 → effect.stylize.emboss 1 → effect.blur.unfocus 1 → effect.photo.vignette 1 → effect.noise.reduce 16 → effect.photo.glow 18.

- effect.distort.bulge multi_tile_600x400 default: engine GPU vs CPU worst 2 > 1 (1 channels)
- effect.distort.bulge multi_tile_600x400: op-gpu vs CPU worst 2 > 1
- effect.photo.glow multi_tile_600x400 radius=20 (max): engine GPU vs CPU worst 2 > 1 (1 channels)
- effect.photo.red_eye_removal multi_tile_600x400 saturation=50 (mid): engine GPU vs CPU worst 1 > 0 (3 channels)
- effect.photo.red_eye_removal multi_tile_600x400 saturation=100 (max): engine GPU vs CPU worst 1 > 0 (10 channels)
- effect.photo.soften_portrait multi_tile_600x400 warmth=19 (max-1): engine GPU vs CPU worst 2 > 1 (112 channels)
